components.label: Sparse title representation
components.notes: Sparse bag-of-ngrams projection over title text; no learned embedding layer in the shipped scorer.

components.label: Engineered thumbnail representation
components.notes: Handcrafted thumbnail feature extraction remains the explicit baseline representation and safe fallback when the optional tiny CNN or ViT paths are unavailable.

components.label: Handcrafted metadata representation
components.notes: Tabular risk and mismatch features over title, transcript, engagement, and feed metadata.

components.label: Sequence-summary temporal context
components.notes: Channel-history aggregation over prior flags, upload velocity, repeat templates, and engagement anomalies.

components.label: Text sigmoid classifier
components.notes: Probability-producing text head over sparse title features.

components.label: Vision sigmoid classifier
components.notes: Probability-producing thumbnail head over engineered image features.

components.label: Metadata sigmoid classifier
components.notes: Probability-producing metadata head over explicit tabular features.

components.label: History sigmoid classifier
components.notes: Probability-producing history head over sequence-summary channel features.

components.label: Multimodal logistic fusion
components.notes: Logistic fusion over per-head probability stacks.

components.label: Platt calibration layer
components.notes: Probability calibration over fused scores.

components.label: LLM review assist
components.notes: Used for manual report suggestion and wording optimization only; not part of the scoring classifier.

components.label: Text embedding / transformer encoder
components.notes: Optional sentence-transformer path is implemented; sparse title projection remains the fallback path.

components.label: Tiny CNN thumbnail encoder
components.notes: Implemented optional CNN thumbnail path; engineered thumbnail features remain the fallback and still feed anomaly/metadata signals.

components.label: ViT thumbnail encoder
components.notes: Implemented optional ViT thumbnail path with runtime priority over the tiny CNN and engineered vision fallback.

components.label: VAE anomaly signal
components.notes: Implemented packaging-anomaly head over combined thumbnail and metadata features.

components.label: LSTM temporal encoder
components.notes: Implemented optional temporal LSTM path trained on recent channel-item sequences, with summary-derived runtime proxy when explicit sequence history is unavailable.

components.label: Reinforcement-learned action policy
components.notes: Implemented feature-flagged threshold-default, rl-shadow, and rl-live modes backed by simulation artifacts plus runtime guardrails.

components.label: Cross-platform TruthLens client
components.notes: Implemented platform-neutral mobile analyze/review contract so non-extension clients can consume resolved watch context, scoring, prompt state, and draft suggestions.

components.label: Android client
components.notes: Implemented native Jetpack Compose Android MVP companion/share client for share-intake, analyze, optimize, report, verify, and local session persistence.

components.label: Stronger end-to-end multimodal encoder stack
components.notes: Planned future work beyond the current bounded optional encoder paths.

components.label: Richer transcript and video understanding
components.notes: Planned deeper video/timeline reasoning beyond thumbnail, watch metadata, and transcript excerpts.

components.label: Deeper moderation analytics
components.notes: Planned operator and analytics tooling beyond the current extension, API, and Android companion scope.
